Jharkhand: bhagvan birsa munda ke samadhi sthal pahunche Hemant Soren, pushp arpit kar kiya naman | Ranchi
Jharkhand sthapna divas ke mauke par mukhyamantri hemant soren bhagvan birsa munda ke samadhi sthal pahunche. yahan unhonne bhagvan birsa munda ko pushp arpit kar shraddhanjli di aur naman kiya. dharti aaba birsa munda ke sangharsh, balidan aur unke aadarshon ko yad karte hue mukhyamantri ne unhen shraddhasuman arpit kie.
